description:
## Problem

Octo_pi defines defaults for `app.tree.filter.{default,noTools,userOnly,labeledOnly,all,cycleForward,cycleBackward}` and has handler stubs in components, but **no tree selector component exists to host them** — they only fire while a tree-selector modal is mounted. Additionally, **four upstream actions are missing entirely** from our defaults: `app.tree.foldOrUp`, `app.tree.unfoldOrDown`, `app.tree.editLabel`, `app.tree.toggleLabelTimestamp`.

## Upstream component

`tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/components/tree-selector.ts` (~1200 lines).

**Activated via**:
- `/tree` slash command (`interactive-mode.ts:2473`)
- `app.session.tree` action (default key empty; user can bind)
- Both call `showTreeSelector(initialSelectedId?)` (`interactive-mode.ts:4096-4223`)
- Mounted via `showSelector` modal pattern (`interactive-mode.ts:3682-3693`) — replaces editor in `editorContainer` and grabs focus.

## Bindings consumed (handler at `tree-selector.ts:899-1003`)

| Action | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `tui.select.up` / `down` | up/down | Move selection (with wrap) |
| `app.tree.foldOrUp` | `ctrl+left`, `alt+left` | If foldable+unfolded → fold; else jump to previous segment start |
| `app.tree.unfoldOrDown` | `ctrl+right`, `alt+right` | If folded → unfold; else jump to next segment start/branch end |
| `tui.editor.cursorLeft` OR `tui.select.pageUp` | left / pageUp | Page up by `maxVisibleLines` (note: cursorLeft is **repurposed** here) |
| `tui.editor.cursorRight` OR `tui.select.pageDown` | right / pageDown | Page down |
| `tui.select.confirm` | enter | Trigger `onSelect(id)` |
| `tui.select.cancel` | escape, ctrl+c | First clears search query if non-empty, else `onCancel()` |
| `app.tree.filter.default` | `ctrl+d` | filterMode = `"default"` |
| `app.tree.filter.noTools` | `ctrl+t` | toggle `"no-tools"` ↔ `"default"` |
| `app.tree.filter.userOnly` | `ctrl+u` | toggle `"user-only"` ↔ `"default"` |
| `app.tree.filter.labeledOnly` | `ctrl+l` | toggle `"labeled-only"` ↔ `"default"` |
| `app.tree.filter.all` | `ctrl+a` | toggle `"all"` ↔ `"default"` |
| `app.tree.filter.cycleForward` | `ctrl+o` | Cycle: default → no-tools → user-only → labeled-only → all |
| `app.tree.filter.cycleBackward` | `shift+ctrl+o` | Reverse cycle |
| `tui.editor.deleteCharBackward` | backspace | Delete last char from search query |
| `app.tree.editLabel` | `shift+l` | Trigger `onLabelEdit(id, label)` |
| `app.tree.toggleLabelTimestamp` | `shift+t` | Toggles `showLabelTimestamps` boolean |
| (anything else printable) | — | Append to search query, clear folds, re-apply filter |

Mode list (hardcoded, `tree-selector.ts:967, 974`): `["default", "no-tools", "user-only", "labeled-only", "all"]`. Filter changes call `foldedNodes.clear(); applyFilter()`.

## Selection callbacks

- **`onSelect(entryId)`** — interactive-mode handles confirmation flow with optional summarization (`interactive-mode.ts:4111-4209`). Shows extension selector `"Summarize branch?"` with options `["No summary", "Summarize", "Summarize with custom prompt"]`. If summarizing, sets `defaultEditor.onEscape = () => session.abortBranchSummary()`. Calls `session.navigateTree(entryId, {summarize, customInstructions})`. **Defer the summarization flow to a separate ticket; first iteration uses no-op `onSelect` or simple navigate.**
- **`onCancel()`** — closes modal.
- **`onLabelEdit(id, label)`** — interactive-mode wires this to `sessionManager.appendLabelChange(id, label)`.

## Required defaults to add to `OctoPi.TUI.Keybindings`

```elixir
"app.tree.foldOrUp" => %{keys: ["ctrl+left", "alt+left"], description: "Fold tree branch or move up"},
"app.tree.unfoldOrDown" => %{keys: ["ctrl+right", "alt+right"], description: "Unfold tree branch or move down"},
"app.tree.editLabel" => %{keys: ["shift+l"], description: "Edit tree label"},
"app.tree.toggleLabelTimestamp" => %{keys: ["shift+t"], description: "Toggle tree label timestamps"},
```

(Defaults for `app.tree.filter.*` already exist in `keybindings.ex` and are correct.)

## Files likely created/modified

- New: `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/tree_selector.ex`.
- Update: `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/keybindings.ex`.
- Update: `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex` to wire `/tree` slash command and `app.session.tree` action to a `show_tree_selector/0` function mirroring `interactive-mode.ts:4096`.

## Suggested subticket carving

1. Selector component skeleton: select / confirm / cancel + standard nav.
2. Filter modes + cycle (the seven `app.tree.filter.*`) — most of the default-key actions become live here.
3. Fold / unfold + segment-start navigation (`app.tree.foldOrUp` / `unfoldOrDown`).
4. Search query (typing chars filters; backspace deletes).
5. Label editing (`shift+l`) + timestamp toggle (`shift+t`).
6. Integration with session navigation + summarization (`onSelect` flow with `session.navigateTree`).

## Notes

Largest ticket in the epic. The next agent should re-shape into subtickets if useful. Page-up/down in this selector intentionally reuses `tui.editor.cursorLeft/Right` AS WELL AS `tui.select.pageUp/Down` — port both code paths (`tree-selector.ts:921-926`).
title: Tree selector component + tree navigation actions
